mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 200k, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in private demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and reduces earnings risk, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1450 and RSAFS > 730000 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds, or the interaction effect (joint IC) is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 for two consecutive months signals weakening real economic output, which increases the risk of corporate earnings contraction and triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO remains below 100 for two months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and CPIAUCSL remains above 325, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy environment that suppresses inflation expectations and raises real interest rates, increasing discount rates on equity cash flows and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and CPIAUCSL > 325, or the interaction IC is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 730,000 million dollars, combined with a drop in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2.0% annualized, signals a weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the risk of corporate revenue stagnation and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS < 730000 and GDPC1 < 2.0, or the joint IC is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% and a decline in non-farm payroll growth below 100k signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to lower corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE > 4.5 and PAYEMS < 100, or the interaction IC is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 for three consecutive months indicates a structural supply-side slowdown, which increases input cost volatility and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO remains below 102.0 for three months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is above -0.03.
